changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names (Bio_ClinicalBERT → ClinicalBERT) and simplified output descriptions. Added ClinicalBERT which was mentioned as 'Bio_ClinicalBERT' in the text.
Simplified ROUGE variants to base metric name. Normalized entity-grid and NSP metric names. R 12 is just an average of ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-2, so it's covered by ROUGE.
No LLMs were used as judges in this paper. The paper mentions BERT/BioBERT but only for next-sentence prediction as an automatic metric, not as evaluators of generated outputs.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. The paper focuses on dataset analysis and automatic evaluation of extractive baselines.

overall_notes: This paper primarily introduces a new clinical summarization dataset (CLINSUM) and analyzes its characteristics. It evaluates extractive summarization baselines using automatic metrics but does not include human evaluation or LLM-as-judge evaluation. The paper focuses on dataset analysis and implications for future model development rather than comprehensive model evaluation.
